issues.explanation: Chapter 40 replays the Chapter 39 scene in which Liu Biao offers Liu Bei Jingzhou and Liu Bei refuses out of loyalty, then repeats essentially the same refusal again after Liu Qi's envoy arrives. This makes the opening feel like a rewind rather than a continuation.
issues.suggested_fix: Open with Liu Biao's worsening illness or Cao Cao's southern campaign, and retain only one clearly distinct refusal: Liu Bei's earlier refusal of opportunistic seizure, followed later by his refusal of the formal entrustment after Liu Biao's death.
